note: Phase 17 evaluation set: 30 real ShapesOS requests run through the real chat loop against the seeded workspace (scripts/eval/seed.ts). Each task has a deterministic check; subjective tasks also carry a rubric judged by the copy workload on real runs. dryRun is the scripted FAKE model's replies (MOCK) so CI proves the harness, never the model. Do not edit a frozen task in place: add a new id so results stay comparable.
